notes.title: Version 1.2!
notes.content:
Version 1.2 is out!

Features and updates:
- added new languages (Spanish and Romanian)
- new options scheme
- 60, 50 and 30 fps modes
- old-style "scanline" layout
- enemies now have more health and the whole game is a bit harder
- a few more levels have been added

Future update will include:
- new levels
- new mechanics (waterfalls)
- French translations
